    The sectional tree is a Dynkin tree #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 2: combining the preceding steps for the tree Δ of sectional paths of a finite stable translation quiver with a finite-dimensional scalar mesh category.

    • Δ is a tree (isTree): it is connected through parents, and its edges are the parent edges.
    • Long paths vanish in Π(Δ) (PreprojectiveNilpotent.lean), so n_i = dim P_i is finite and ∑_{j∼i} n_j < 2 n_i (PreprojectiveDimension.lean).
    • Hence Δ is a star model with at most one arm, or with three arms satisfying ∑ p_i/(p_i + 1) < 2 (classify_tree).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
